text:
Lina P: Heads up — 101 overpass has a stalled truck, traffic crawling southbound. Took an extra 25 mins.
Raj S: Ugh, saw that. VTA just announced a bus detour that adds a stop at Market & 9th.
Becca M: Anyone coming in from the Peninsula? Curious if 280 is messy too.
Drew T: 280 was fine for me at 7:30 but heard 101 is the nightmare. I flipped to public transit — buses are slower but steady.
OfficeBot: Reminder: Office kitchen restock scheduled for 11:30. Please toss empty milk cartons in recycling.
Lina P: Can someone pick up coffee pods? Our stash is at critical levels. :eyes:
Raj S: I can swing by the store, grabbing oat milk and pods. Ping me if you want anything.
Becca M: Vote: in-office or remote for today? Reply with "in" or "remote" so we know how many desks to expect.
Drew T: in
Lina P: remote, bridge backup made it not worth it
Raj S: in (but may be 20 min late)
Becca M: remote — saving myself from parking roulette
WeatherBot: Heavy rain and gusty winds advisory until 13:00. Localized flooding on low-lying roads. Drive safe.
Lina P: Flooding note — the sidewalks near 3rd & Harrison have standing water. Wear boots if walking.
Raj S: Thanks for the offers — @Becca M if you want a pod, I'll bring extras when I get to the office.
Becca M: You're a saint, Raj. Venmo incoming.
Drew T: Meme: "Commuter starter pack: umbrella, bad attitude, questionable coffee" :joy: (posted image)
Lina P: Also quick FYI for folks: shuttle will detour to pick up at 4th & Folsom because of the truck blockage. @OfficeBot confirm?
OfficeBot: Shuttle route updated — additional stop at 4th & Folsom until 10:00.
Raj S: Ok heading out. Will update if 101 clears.
Becca M: I'll log on early so the standup isn't affected.
Lina P: Thanks team. Keep this thread if routes change or if anyone needs extra hands with parking. :thumbsup:
